nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Amazon Public Marketplace Data: product/detail API.

asins.description: List of ASINs, up to 40, formatted as comma separated uppercase letters/numbers, matching `^[A-Z0-9]+(,[A-Z0-9]+){0,39}$`.

deliveryZip.description: Shipping zip code used to obtain shipping related pricing, such as `10001`, `10115`, `EC1A 1BB`.

language.description: Response language locale code, such as `en_US`, `de_DE`, `fr_FR`, `ja_JP`, `it_IT`, `es_ES`, `pt_BR`, `en_GB`, `zh_CN`.

returnAuthorsReviews.description: Whether to return the author comment list `authorsReviews`.

returnBoughtTogether.description: Whether to return items frequently purchased together `boughtTogether`.

returnRelatedProducts.description: Whether to return the related product list `relatedProducts`.

name: nexscope_data_amazon_product_detail
title: Amazon Public Marketplace Data: product/detail API
